items.title: 3 Agriculture Stocks to Watch as Food Inflation Keeps Supply Chains in Focus
items.summary: Inflation fears are lingering, energy costs remain jumpy and food prices are still in focus, so attention is shifting to the less glamorous plumbing of the global food system. Supply of fertilizers, seeds, crop protection and cold storage does not grab headlines, yet these businesses can feel inflation, interest rates and tech selloffs in very direct ways.
